mentions.name: Nonoverse
mentions.description: This is an iOS logic puzzle game based on nonograms. New levels are being added, with a planned garden theme for extra cosy vibes; the new assets are being drawn in Inkscape without AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: Nonoverse: an iOS logic puzzle game (nonograms!), I’m working on adding a new batch of levels. I’m considering a garden theme for extra cosy vibes, but I’m still in the planning stage and drawing assets right now (in inkscape, no AI).
